target.title: fix(agents): keep chunkString and buildResumeMessage truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two UTF-16 truncation sites in the agent runtime that could produce broken U+FFFD replacement characters:

1. **`chunkString`** (`src/agents/bash-tools.shared.ts`) — splits large bash exec output into 8192-code-unit chunks for transport. Emoji crossing the chunk boundary gets split into a lone surrogate.

2. **`buildResumeMessage`** (`src/agents/subagent-orphan-recovery.ts`) — truncates subagent task descriptions at 2000 code units when building the resume message after gateway restart. Emoji at the boundary produces a broken character.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **`chunkString`**: Replace `input.slice(i, i + limit)` with `sliceUtf16Safe(input, i, i + limit)` using the existing helper already imported in the same file.
- **`buildResumeMessage`**: Replace `task.slice(0, maxTaskLen)` with `truncateUtf16Safe(task, maxTaskLen)`.

## User Impact

- Bash exec output chunking no longer corrupts emoji at chunk boundaries during transport.
- Subagent resume messages after gateway restart display clean task descriptions without broken characters.

## Evidence

### Tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.shared.test.ts src/agents/task-resume-utf16-safe.test.ts src/agents/subagent-orphan-recovery.test.ts

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  33 passed (33)
```

### Standalone production-path proof

```
$ node --import tsx scripts/proof-chunk-resume-utf16-safe.mjs
node=v22.22.0  head=<PR-head-sha>
--- chunkString ---
inputCodeUnits=8194  beforeFix_surrogateAt8191=U+d83d
afterFix_chunks=2  chunkHasLoneSurrogate=false  dataPreserved=true
--- buildResumeMessage ---
taskCodeUnits=2001  beforeFix_surrogateAt1999=U+d83d
afterFix_truncatedLen=1999  hasLoneSurrogate=false
result=PASS
```

### Files Changed (4 files, +86/-5)

```
 src/agents/bash-tools.shared.ts        | 11 ++++++---
 src/agents/bash-tools.shared.test.ts   | 37 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 src/agents/subagent-orphan-recovery.ts |  3 +-
 src/agents/task-resume-utf16-safe.test.ts | 30 +++++++++++++++++++++
```

## Risk checklist

Did user-visible behavior change? (Yes/No)
Yes. Bash exec output chunks and subagent resume messages no longer emit U+FFFD for emoji-boundary text.

Did config, environment, or migration behavior change? (Yes/No)
No.

Did security, auth, secrets, network, or tool execution behavior change? (Yes/No)
No.

What is the highest-risk area?
Agent bash exec output chunking and subagent orphan recovery message formatting.

How is that risk mitigated?
Both changes reuse the existing `sliceUtf16Safe`/`truncateUtf16Safe` helper with established test coverage. For ordinary input (no emoji at boundary), chunk sizes and content are identical to the old behavior. Existing tests (30 cases) pass without changes.
